facts_of_case: The respondent-husband was granted divorce by the trial court. The petitioner-wife challenged this order and a stay was granted by the Division Bench. Despite this, the respondent-husband solemnized his second marriage with Pooja.

legal_principles.principle: A party to a dissolved marriage cannot marry again until the appeal period has expired or the appeal has been dismissed.
legal_principles.held: According to Section 15 of the Act, a party to the dissolved marriage could marry again if period of filing an appeal has expired or the appeal has been dismissed.
cited_cases: Jasbir Kaur vs. Kuljit Singh, (2008) 2 RCR (Civil) 929

legal_principles.principle: A party to a dissolved marriage has a duty to make inquiries that no appeal has been filed within the period of limitation or that the appeal has been dismissed.
legal_principles.held: Such a spouse cannot sit at home and wait for the summons to come because service of summons may not necessarily be affected on the winning spouse
cited_cases: Jasbir Kaur vs. Kuljit Singh, (2008) 2 RCR (Civil) 929

outcome.final_order: The operation of the judgment and decree granting divorce to the respondent-husband was stayed till further orders.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for stay of judgment
